name: check_brand
title: Check the brand
description: Runs blazon check on the brand, without plugins, and returns its findings and counts. `passed` is false when the brand has errors, and values read from such a brand can be wrong. Returns at most `limit` findings (default 50, at most 500); `counts` stay whole. Not for reading a value: use get_token.

severity.description: List only the findings at this level or worse. The counts stay whole

limit.description: The most findings to return, from 1 to 500; default 50

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

passed.description: True when the brand has no errors

errors.description: How many findings are errors, whatever `severity` or `limit` asked for

counts.description: How many findings the brand has at each level

code.description: The finding code, such as starter-logo-unchanged

findingsTotal.description: How many findings there are before `limit` cut the list

name: list_tokens
title: List the tokens
description: Lists the design tokens of the brand, or of one group, or of one type, each with its path, type and value, in the order the token files write them. Use it to find a path or to read many values at once. For a token's CSS variable names and rules use get_token; for the brand's usage rules use get_rules. An answer over 40000 characters is cut to whole tokens, and `tokensTotal` says how many matched: narrow with `group` or `type`.

group.description: A group path, for example color or color.brand. Leave out for every token

type.description: A token type, for example color, dimension or fontFamily. Leave out for every type. An unknown type is refused with the list of types

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

group.description: The group asked for, as a clean path. Absent when the whole brand was listed

type.description: The type asked for. Absent when every type was listed

path.description: The token path, to pass to get_token

type.description: The token type, such as color

value.description: The value as CSS needs it, with aliases resolved: a string or a number

aliasOf.description: The token this one is an alias of, when it is one

tokens.description: The tokens, cut to fit the size limit

tokensTotal.description: How many tokens matched before the size limit cut the list

name: get_token
title: Read a token
description: Looks up one design token of the brand: its value, type, the CSS variable names it gets, and the rules that apply to it. Use it for the value of a path you know; a group path is refused. For a path you do not know use list_tokens.

path.description: The token path, for example color.brand.primary. A path from list_tokens works

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

token.description: The token, with its CSS variable names, the rules that apply to it and the file that writes it

type.description: The token type, such as color

value.description: The value as CSS needs it, with aliases resolved

name: get_rules
title: Read the brand rules
description: Lists the brand rules (allowed uses, approved color pairs, logo restrictions) of a token or a group of tokens, or of the whole brand when no path is given. The whole brand can be larger than the size limit (40000 characters): give a path, or read the resource blazon://rules, which is not cut.

path.description: A token or group path, for example color.brand. Leave out for the whole brand

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

kind.description: What the rules are for: one token, a group of tokens, or the whole brand

path.description: The path the rules are for; empty for the whole brand

entries.description: The rules, each with the path it applies to (`at`) and what it says: usage, pairs or logo restrictions

name: can_use
title: Can this color be used here
description: Answers whether one color token may be text on another color token, by the brand rules. Set `role` to ui for a focus ring, border or icon stroke: it is judged against the 3:1 non-text contrast and the pairs rules do not apply. A denied answer is a normal result (`allowed` is false, `reason` names the rule), not an error. For a color you have not picked, find one with list_tokens and type color.

fg.description: The text color token path, for example text.primary

bg.description: The background color token path, for example surface.background

role.description: What the first color is: text (default), judged by the usage, pairs and WCAG text rules, or ui for a focus ring, border or icon stroke, judged by the usage rules and the 3:1 non-text contrast

theme.description: Judge the pair in this context of the resolver's theme modifier, such as dark. Default: the default tokens

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

allowed.description: True when the brand allows this text color on this background

reason.description: The rule that decided the answer

fg.description: The text color token that was asked about

bg.description: The background color token that was asked about

role.description: What the first color was judged as: text or ui

theme.description: The theme context the pair was judged in; absent for the default tokens

contrast.description: The contrast ratio of the pair, the strictest WCAG level it meets, and for role ui the threshold it had to reach

name: get_fonts
title: Read the brand fonts
description: Gets the font stylesheets and font files the brand loads, and for each font family a token names whether the brand loads it. Use it to load the same fonts as the brand instead of typing a font address. For the family a token names, use get_token.

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

stylesheets.description: Addresses of the font stylesheets to load

files.description: Font files the brand ships. Empty when the fonts come from a stylesheet

families.description: Each font family a token names, with the tokens that name it and `loaded`, whether the brand loads it

name: get_logo
title: Read the brand logo
description: Gets the brand logo variants for light and dark surfaces, their files, and the rules for each logo: clear space, minimum size, lockups, and the backgrounds that forbid it. Use it before placing a logo. For the brand's other rules use get_rules.

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

variants.description: The logo variants (onLight, onDark), each with its file and whether the file was found

assets.description: The logo assets, each with its id, file, the variants it serves and its rules: clear space, minimum size, lockups

name: get_shadcn
title: Read the shadcn/ui variables
description: Gets the shadcn/ui variables the brand supplies (theme.shadcn): which token each variable takes, its value, and the variables nothing supplies. Use it when the site uses shadcn/ui. It compiles the brand when called, so it needs no build and is never out of date.

warnings.description: Lines blazon printed on standard error, such as a warning that the brand has errors. Empty when blazon said nothing

brandHasErrors.description: True when the brand has errors, so values read from it may be wrong. Run check_brand to see them

truncated.description: True when the answer was cut to fit the size limit. `notice` says how to narrow the question

notice.description: Present when the answer was cut: how much was kept and how to ask a narrower question

variables.description: Each shadcn variable the brand supplies, by name, with the token it takes, its value and where the pick came from

unsupplied.description: The shadcn variables nothing supplies. They are questions for the brand owner, not for a guess
